subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Mechanism Design Basics
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Mechanism Design Basics.

hook.text: Two children fight over a cake. A parent says: one cuts, the other chooses. Both get fair slices.

buildup.text: Mechanism design is reverse game theory: instead of predicting behavior in a game, you design the game to produce.

discovery.text: Vickrey's second-price auction makes honest bidding optimal. You bid your true value because you only pay.

twist.text: Good mechanisms make cooperation the selfish choice. Like traffic lights, the rule aligns individual incentives.

climax.text: When behavior is bad, ask: is the mechanism wrong? Changing the rules often works better than trying to change people.

punchline.text: Don't fix the players. Fix the rules.

quiz.question: What makes Vickrey's second-price auction effective?
options: It ensures the lowest bidder always wins
Honest bidding is the optimal strategy because winners pay the second-highest price
It eliminates all competition between bidders
